description: Convert between newtons, kilonewtons, pounds-force, kilograms-force, dynes and ounces-force with exact factors.

faqs.a: 1 lbf = 4.4482216152605 N exactly (defined by the international avoirdupois pound, 0.45359237 kg, times standard gravity 9.80665 m/s²).
faqs.q: How many newtons are in a pound-force?

faqs.a: Yes. 1 kgf is defined as exactly 9.80665 N, and 1 dyn is defined as exactly 1e-5 N (the CGS unit of force).
Force is mass times acceleration. kgf measures weight (mass × standard gravity), while kg is mass. The converter treats 1 kgf = 9.80665 N under standard gravity.
faqs.q: What is the difference between kgf and kg?
